scope: Pilot guest experience only; Admin components are deferred to UX-04.1.

components.name: SearchField
components.purpose: Capture a Lao or English intent query and let the user submit, clear or choose a suggestion.
components.behavior: Enter submits; Escape closes suggestions; arrow keys move through suggestions; clear returns focus to the field.
components.acceptance: Has a visible label or accessible name, logical keyboard order, 44px actions and an announced loading/error state.

components.name: IntentSuggestionChip
components.purpose: Convert a common decision intent such as budget, district or occasion into a reusable search constraint.
components.behavior: Selecting updates the result set and announces the new result count; removal restores the previous constraint.
components.acceptance: Selection is communicated by text/state as well as color and remains understandable at 200% text size.

components.name: SearchViewSwitcher
components.purpose: Switch one result set between Video, List and Map without losing the query or filters.
components.behavior: Keeps search state and scroll context where practical; active view is exposed with aria-pressed or tab semantics.
components.acceptance: The active view is obvious without relying on color and every control is at least 44px.

components.name: VideoResultCard
components.purpose: Present a review-led result with enough place facts to decide whether to open the Place Page.
components.behavior: Opens the canonical Place Page; a failed or missing video shows a poster, explanation and source/place recovery action.
components.acceptance: Never creates a dead end; Sponsored and source attribution are visible before opening the result.

components.name: MapResult
components.purpose: Connect a map marker to the same canonical Place record shown in Video and List views.
components.behavior: Selecting a marker opens its summary card; selecting the card opens the Place Page; keyboard users can reach the equivalent result list.
components.acceptance: Map is not the only route to results and selected state is conveyed by label/shape as well as color.

components.name: PlaceHeroAndActionBar
components.purpose: Show the place identity and give immediate Map, Call, Message and Share actions when available.
components.behavior: Unavailable actions are omitted or explained, never shown as working controls; external actions identify their destination.
components.acceptance: Core facts and checked date remain visible without playing media; action labels are explicit and touch-safe.

components.name: ReviewVideoRail
components.purpose: Collect independent review links for one Place while preserving creator attribution and source ownership.
components.behavior: Opens the original source; unavailable content shows a fallback and does not remove the rest of the Place Page.
components.acceptance: Creator and platform are visible, links are external, and the component does not imply that the Platform owns the review.

components.name: DecisionSummaryCard
components.purpose: Summarize the practical facts that influence a go/no-go decision without replacing source evidence.
components.behavior: Unknown and stale values are stated explicitly; it links to the detailed fact or source where available.
components.acceptance: Does not invent a recommendation and never treats Unknown as Closed, Expensive or Unavailable.

components.name: MenuItemCard
components.purpose: Help users inspect a real menu item using a photo, name, price and evidence date.
components.behavior: Missing images use a neutral placeholder; unknown prices are written as unknown rather than zero.
components.acceptance: Kip is formatted consistently, the image has useful alt text, and stale price evidence is visibly labelled.

components.name: RelatedPlaceCard
components.purpose: Offer a small set of comparable places based on disclosed category, district or price rules.
components.behavior: Opens the canonical Place Page and keeps Sponsored placement separate from organic similarity.
components.acceptance: The reason for similarity is visible and paid placement is never presented as an organic match.

components.name: TrustAndDisclosure
components.purpose: Explain source, checked date, partner status, Sponsored status and stale data without overclaiming verification.
components.behavior: A short label opens or reveals a plain-language explanation; the same words follow CON-02 and CON-05.
components.acceptance: Partner does not mean best-rated or verified; Sponsored is always readable and not communicated by color alone.

components.name: FeedbackState
components.purpose: Handle loading, empty, error and recovery consistently across Discover, Search and Place.
components.behavior: Critical errors persist until acknowledged; retry preserves the query or Place context; status changes are announced.
components.acceptance: Every error provides a next action, loading does not trap focus, and empty is not confused with a system failure.
